hypotheses.title: Domain-Invariant Multi-Physics Crest Co-Training with Analog Importance Weighting and B=2 Visible-Collar Poisson Emission
hypotheses.physical_signature: 25 km rolling basin-standardized gradient crests, profile curvatures, and structure-tensor coherences across topography/1m-LiDAR, shallow/upward-continued magnetics, isostatic gravity, basement depth, and electrical conductivity, co-trained across named geothermal analog fields (Dixie Valley, Brady, Desert Peak) and fold-visible regional catalogue with domain-similarity importance weights and B=2 (200 m) visible-catalogue side-lobe pruning.
hypotheses.why_it_catches_missing_faults: Removes basin-level elevation/depth/regional-field offsets that caused H33-F's covariate shift (AUC 0.917) so fine-scale intra-basin and step-over fault signatures learned from densely drilled geothermal fields transfer to unmapped basins without copying the fixed H19-5 skeleton.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_repo_work: Unlike H33-F (trained only inside 3 analog masks on raw non-stationary bands, P1 delta -0.093) and H33-6 (95.3% dot copy of H27-4/D2.8), H33-R3-1 standardizes all features locally by basin, co-trains with importance weighting on fold-visible faults only, and emits a 100% standalone 37,654-dot R=300m Poisson pack.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Intrabasin Pleistocene Lake Lahontan paleo-shoreline scarps or buried volcanic dike contacts producing aligned topographic and potential-field gradient crests without tectonic slip.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_rank: Rank 1 (highest runnable; substantial improvement over prior H33-F analog transfer and fold-safe physical baseline)
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (~45s CPU on cached 121-channel stack; 0 external downloads required)
hypotheses.external_source_check: Uses SHA-256-pinned GeoDAWN/3DEP/GDR-1391 mirror channels already staged in .cache/data and .cache/features.

hypotheses.title: Multi-Scale Vertical-Persistence Potential-Field & Conductive-Basement Worm Network with Geothermometer Upflow Prior
hypotheses.physical_signature: Label-free geometric-mean persistence of magnetic and gravity edges across sigma=1, 2, 4 px and 150 m upward continuation, gated by >=2 corroborating physical families (magnetics, gravity, conductive basement, tectonic scarp) and boosted in GDR 1391 quartz/chalcedony/cation geothermometer upflow catchments.
hypotheses.why_it_catches_missing_faults: Superficial erosional scarps decay rapidly under upward continuation and coarse smoothing, whereas deep basement-cutting faults that channel hydrothermal fluids persist across depth scales even when concealed beneath quaternary playa/alluvial cover.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_repo_work: Unlike H33-6 (single-scale sigma=2 px edge-normal dot product used to swap 5% of H27-4), H33-R3-2 is a completely label-free cross-scale vertical-persistence worm detector.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Steeply dipping plutonic or metamorphic intrusive contacts and caldera ring-margin boundaries with deep magnetic susceptibility and density contrast.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_rank: Rank 2 (strong label-free physical baseline without catalogue supervision)
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~15s CPU on cached feature stack)
hypotheses.external_source_check: All inputs staged and SHA-256 verified in .cache/data and .cache/features.

hypotheses.title: Transtensional Step-Over & Dilatational Strain-Gradient Relay Bridge Detector
hypotheses.physical_signature: Anisotropic stress-concentration lobes (200 m < d_vis <= 2,500 m) around fold-visible fault terminations coupled with positive geodetic dilatation/shear rate and multi-physics vertical-persistence ridge crests.
hypotheses.why_it_catches_missing_faults: Great Basin geothermal upflow zones preferentially occupy small-throw horsetail splays, wing cracks, and relay ramps at normal-fault terminations (Faulds & Hinz, 2015) where vertical scarp relief drops below regional mapping thresholds.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_repo_work: Unlike withdrawn C2 (which grafted full-catalogue qfaults tips onto static H19-5), H33-R3-3 computes fault tips strictly from fold-visible catalogue traces and couples them with the label-free vertical-persistence ridge surface.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Alluvial fan apexes and radial bajada distributary channels emerging at range-front fault tips.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_rank: Rank 3 (targeted boost near fault terminations; depends on visible tip density)
hypotheses.external_source_check: All inputs staged in .cache/data and .cache/features; tips derived from fold-visible catalogue only.

hypotheses.title: Field-Verified DOE GDR #1682 BRIDGE LiDAR Fault-Pick Supervised Transfer
layers: DOE GDR #1682 GIS Files.zip (Dixie Valley & Gabbs Valley field-verified LiDAR fault picks)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Supervised transfer trained exclusively on field-verified fine-scale LiDAR fault picks in Dixie Valley and Gabbs Valley.
hypotheses.why_it_catches_missing_faults: Provides genuine field-verified sub-regional fault traces omitted from the regional compilation.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_repo_work: Uses independent field-verified target traces rather than subsetting labels.tif.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene pluvial shoreline berms in Dixie Valley.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_rank: Rank 4 (high theoretical ceiling, but not runnable without external archive)
hypotheses.external_source_check: Official source: https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1682 (CC BY 4.0, GIS Files.zip, 3.79 MB). Unreachable from this sandbox because outbound access is restricted to github.com/pypi.org/npmjs.org.

hypotheses.title: EarthScope / UNR NGL Dense GNSS Station Velocity & InSAR Line-of-Sight Strain Discontinuity Inversion
layers: UNR Nevada Geodetic Laboratory station velocity table (http://geodesy.unr.edu/)
ASF ARIA/OPERA Sentinel-1 InSAR displacement velocity maps
hypotheses.physical_signature: Sub-10 km localized crustal velocity step discontinuities across active creeping or aseismically deforming geothermal fault zones.
hypotheses.why_it_catches_missing_faults: Replaces the over-smoothed 100 km competition strain bands (geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate) with fault-scale geodetic deformation gradients.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_repo_work: Uses raw station/InSAR geodetic observations rather than pre-smoothed bands 4, 7, 8.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_rank: Rank 5 (requires external geodetic data not in sandbox)
hypotheses.external_source_check: Official source: Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (http://geodesy.unr.edu/) and NASA/ASF OPERA (https://asf.alaska.edu/). Unreachable under sandbox outbound host whitelist.
